sections.heading: Sign-off, Valuation & Risk Oversight
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios ($5-25bn per engagement; $50bn+ cumulative), independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions before production release.

Independently review and validate derivatives pricing and sensitivity outputs across rates, FX, and inflation, ensuring sensitivities and scenario impacts reconcile at portfolio-level risk aggregates.

sections.heading: Scenario, Stress & Liquidity Analytics
bullets: Led the design and ongoing development of an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection and scenario engine (base, stress, reverse-stress), delivering forward-looking liquidity and surplus visibility across ALM horizons.
Architected configurable time-bucketed liquidity-gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year) supporting funding-ratio, refinancing, and asset-allocation decisions.
Translated interest-rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities into investment-committee-ready narratives for senior stakeholders and clients' Heads of Risk.

bullets: Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consultants migrating to the PFaroe ALM and portfolio-analytics platform, validating model outputs post-deployment.

roles.title: Senior Consultant - IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, coordinating actuarial, finance, risk, and IT functions on adoption, governance documentation, and regulatory-readiness milestones.

sections.heading: Pension ALM, LDI & Total-Portfolio Risk Advisory
bullets: Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization based on VaR and CVaR on Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition and near-optimal frontier analysis to test the robustness of allocation recommendations.

Led onboarding and the ALM study for a three-plan university pension merger into a new jointly-sponsored plan, developing and validating the model capturing all Funding Policy dynamics and evaluating duration, currency, inflation, and leverage-overlay strategies.

Modelled pension-fund actuarial liabilities alongside all major investment-product types and economic variables, and built stochastic economic scenario generators (Monte Carlo) to assess interest-rate and funding-ratio volatility under base-case and stressed environments.
Delivered ALM studies for Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors, analyzing funding ratio, surplus, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet risk exposures.
Conducted liability-driven investment (LDI) analysis, weighing trade-offs between return objectives, duration alignment, and liquidity for pension-fund clients.

Performed cash-flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk, and advised on Strategic and Tactical Asset Allocation (SAA/TAA) trade-offs via stress testing and sensitivity analysis.
Presented ALM study findings and allocation recommendations to investment committees at Canadian pension-fund clients on-site.
